Strategy: Combine the fixed sweet band between thirty and forty-five with a bonus for residuals near the mean open residual, keeping the mid penalty. This rewards leftovers that are both in the proven band and typical for the state, but the mean band may rarely trigger and the limits are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) + (10 if abs(r - sum(bins) / len(bins)) <= 10 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
